scope: Before/After improvement photo vision OCR contract
decision: Before/After photos are stored as workpack improvement candidates, while actual vision/OCR execution is represented separately by status and analysisMode so the product does not overclaim analysis when OpenAI vision is unconfigured or failed.

analysisModes.vision_ocr: Before/After photo pair was analyzed by OpenAI vision/OCR.
analysisModes.photo_pair_unanalyzed: Before/After photo pair was saved, but vision/OCR is unconfigured or failed.
analysisModes.manual_text: Manual improvement text without a complete Before/After photo pair.

productCopyGuard.previousRisk: The UI could read as if vision/OCR always completed whenever photos were attached.
productCopyGuard.newBehavior: Workspace copy and saved local history now show the vision/OCR status label separately from DB/photo storage.

verification.tests: npm.cmd test -- tests\photo-vision-analysis.test.ts tests\commercial-harness.test.ts tests\operation-improvement-history.test.ts tests\ontology-operation-memory.test.ts tests\workpack-commercial.test.ts

notes: No DB schema changes or data mutations were performed.
OpenAI vision uses OPENAI_API_KEY only for the photo analysis route; missing keys produce an unconfigured status instead of a silent failure.
Photo pair storage and vision/OCR analysis are now separate product concepts.
